description: Removes an edit job that is not finished (a draft, a stale test, a queued, rendering or failed job nobody wants). A draft post made from it stays. Refused for an edit in review or posted, and while the Mac is editing it. Undo brings it back.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: edit_job_discard
title: Discard an edit
